description: Outside the US (send the country): whether a company is in the global LEI register (GLEIF): its legal name, country, local registry number, whether it's active and its ultimate parent. In the US: the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's complaint record (counts, top problems, on-time answers, how often people got relief) and whether it's an FDIC-insured bank; and for a public company, what it reported to the SEC (EDGAR XBRL): revenue, net income and diluted EPS for four fiscal years, the latest quarter against a year earlier, cash and shares outstanding. Use before someone chooses a bank, lender or card, when they're dealing with a problem company, or whenever someone asks how much a company made, grew or earned (send a name or a ticker such as NVDA). Complaint counts grow with company size; compare similar companies. Not investment advice; no stock prices.

company.description: Company name or US stock ticker, e.g. 'Capital One', 'Chime', 'NVDA'

country.description: Country where the company is registered or operates; leave out for the US

months.description: How far back to count; default 24

name: check_company
